local_skills.name: talen-interval-elements
local_skills.guidance: List every declared closed interval, retaining empty incomparable intervals.

local_skills.name: talen-incidence-zeta
local_skills.guidance: Materialize the upper-order indicator in declared label order.

local_skills.name: talen-incidence-delta
local_skills.guidance: Build the incidence identity with zero off-diagonal coefficients.

local_skills.name: talen-incidence-convolution
local_skills.guidance: Convolve two supported integer functions over each closed interval.

local_skills.name: talen-mobius-recursive
local_skills.guidance: Compute the inverse of zeta by triangular recursion.

local_skills.name: talen-mobius-chain-sum
local_skills.guidance: Compute the inverse independently by alternating strict-chain lengths.

local_skills.name: talen-zeta-transform
local_skills.guidance: Accumulate a declared integer vector over upper sets.

local_skills.name: talen-mobius-inversion
local_skills.guidance: Recover a declared vector from its frozen upper-set totals.

local_skills.name: talen-open-interval-euler
local_skills.guidance: Represent reduced Euler coefficients of strict intervals without a physical-space claim.

local_skills.name: talen-convolution-associativity
local_skills.guidance: Compare both parenthesizations of three supported incidence functions.

local_skills.name: talen-product-chain-mobius
local_skills.guidance: Check the product formula against a directly constructed product with a two-element chain.

local_skills.name: talen-dual-mobius
local_skills.guidance: Compute the dual-order inverse and compare its transposed coefficients.

local_skills.name: talen-order-ideals
local_skills.guidance: Enumerate all downward-closed subsets with the empty ideal retained.

local_skills.name: talen-join-irreducible-embedding
local_skills.guidance: Map lattice elements to ideals of their nonzero join-irreducibles and report missing ideals.

local_skills.name: talen-distributivity-witness
local_skills.guidance: Return the first deterministic distributive-law counterexample, or finite exhaustive satisfaction.

local_skills.name: talen-modularity-witness
local_skills.guidance: Return the first modular-law counterexample under its order premise.

local_skills.name: talen-complements
local_skills.guidance: List all complements, including absence and multiplicity, after confirming bounds.

local_skills.name: talen-lattice-representation
local_skills.guidance: Represent lattice identities and label any missing lattice operations without promoting model evidence.

local_skills.name: talen-evidence-gap
local_skills.guidance: Project missing empirical and participant evidence without treating missingness as false data.

local_skills.name: talen-release-gate
local_skills.guidance: Keep protected publication and authority obligations closed on synthetic input.
